items.html: And after all that was needed had been sorted, so that from them all the parts of the four worlds ABYA would be made, afterwards Adam HaRishon was created, to complete and to sort through his deeds and his commandments; for it is in the power of the virtue of the commandments and the prayers to carry out the sortings. But on the contrary, he joined with the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil — which are the above kings — with the dross in them; and then he too died, and all his descendants after him, so that his parts too, which had mixed good with evil like the kings, would be sorted. And this is the secret of reincarnation, as explained in its place. And for this reason too there are angels that die every day and are renewed, as it is written, “who forms His ministers,” etc. And it is enough for one who understands, for the strength of the pen has failed to detail it all.
